scope: Bounded deterministic sampling uses actual recorded movements and covers less frequent wards, ICU, queues and discharge without inventing traffic or changing allocation.
Exact occupied/empty bed transitions take 90ms with a single 150ms flash; unchanged beds and reduced motion never flash.
Complete hospital and controls fit 1280x720, 1440x900 and 1600x1000 desktop screens, including 100 installed Ward A beds, fullscreen, Fit and sidebar resizing.
Previous recorded bed inventory, patient inspectors, continuous routes, live scrubbing, stale seek/run guards and ED queue recovery remain verified.
preservation: Fresh private database backup captured; final read-only hosted preservation and static bundle checks follow deployment.
